title: Plans Within Plans: Hierarchical Actions and Reusable Skills
outcome: Compute option returns with duration discounting and explicit completion.
prerequisites: The mapped chapter and its notation

input_fields.start_time: Nonnegative elapsed time, same unit as deadline.
input_fields.interrupt_after: Optional nonnegative integer executed-step cap for each option.
input_fields.options: Each option has name,initiation:boolean,rewards:nonempty primitive reward list,terminated:boolean,continuation_value:number.

equations.label: EQV10-01
explanations: Equation (10.1) separates where an option may start, how it acts while running, and how it stops.
Start only in `\mathcal{I}_o`; use `\pi_o` for primitive choices; use `\beta_o` to determine termination.

equations.label: EQV10-02
explanations: Equation (10.2) values rewards inside an option and value remaining after variable-duration completion.
Discount internal primitive rewards, then discount continuation by actual primitive steps used.

equations.label: EQV10-03
explanations: Equation (10.3) keeps completion delay separate from total tool cost in parallel workflow.
Take longest dependency chain for time; add all required activity credits for cost.
